name: quelltest
description: Prove your Python tests, don't just count them. Quelltest finds untested edge cases (docstrings, Pydantic models, type hints), writes pytest tests verified through a 5-gate pipeline — Gate 5 injects the violation and requires the test to fail — and scores production readiness. This plugin teaches Claude to operate Quelltest directly via its local MCP server or CLI: find gaps after writing code, write proven tests before committing, reproduce bugs as failing tests. Everything runs locally; no code leaves the machine.
